decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the signs would not be harmful to the appearance of the street scene and highway safety in compliance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements), S.4.3 (Advertisements), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
description: Installation and display of various externally illuminated and non-illuminated signs to public house.
